description: A pulse counter: count incoming triggers and send one out when the count is reached, once or over and over.

params.text: Sets how many incoming triggers it takes to fire the output, 2 to 256.
Starts the count again after firing, so the output fires every time that many triggers arrive; without it the output fires once and then stays quiet until a reset.

inputs.text: A rising edge past 2V sets the count back to zero and re-arms the output.
A rising edge past 2V adds one to the count.
Takes over the OUT ON knob while a cable is here: 0V to 10V covers 2 to 256, and the knob is moved to follow.
A rising edge past 2V flips the loop setting, or with the gate option on the menu holds it on while the voltage is above 0.2V.

outputs.text: A 10V trigger 1ms long when the count is reached.

notes: Nothing happens until triggers arrive at STEP. The module has no clock of its own.
menu: Invert Pulse Logic — sends a trigger out on every incoming trigger except the one the count lands on.
Use Gate For Loop On/Off — makes the loop jack read a level rather than an edge, looping only while the voltage is above 0.2V.
Only Count With Gate On — stops the counting and the output entirely unless the gate option is on and its gate is high.
